diagnostic.title: Bare Hands pointer, pinch and target quality on a replayed trace
diagnostic.description: Replays a synthetic golden trace through the real pointer filter, pinch hysteresis and target resolver. It measures the processing chain, never a camera, a tracker or anyone's hand: the trace holds derived scalars only - no landmarks, no image, no identifier (decision 32).

parameters.name: filter.min_cutoff_hz
parameters.description: One Euro minimum cutoff: lower smooths a still hand and lags a fast one.

parameters.name: filter.beta_cutoff
parameters.description: One Euro speed coefficient: higher follows a fast hand at the cost of jitter.

parameters.name: pinch.press_ratio
parameters.description: Thumb-index ratio below which a contact is pressed.

parameters.name: pinch.release_ratio
parameters.description: Ratio above which a pressed contact releases; the hysteresis band is the gap.

parameters.name: target.assistance
parameters.description: Target assistance factor: 0.5 is the engine default reach, 0 none, 1 double.

metrics.name: replay.frames_count
metrics.description: Frames the replay actually measured. It says how much a run is worth.

metrics.name: click.target_success_ratio
metrics.description: Clicks and right clicks that had a resolved candidate under the hand.

metrics.name: pointer.error_p50_norm
metrics.description: Median filtered-to-raw pointer deviation, as a fraction of image width.

metrics.name: pointer.stationary_jitter_p95_norm
metrics.description: Same deviation restricted to frames where the hand is still.

metrics.name: pinch.false_primary_hz
metrics.description: Thumb-index press/release cycles too short to be meant, per second.

metrics.name: gesture.false_positive_hz
metrics.description: Global gestures suppressed because a capture was held, per second.

metrics.name: interaction.latency_p50_ms
metrics.description: Median time from contact to its outcome.

metrics.name: hand.loss_recovery_p95_ms
metrics.description: 95th percentile of the gap between losing a hand slot and seeing it again.

metrics.name: drag.continuity_ratio
metrics.description: Share of drag frames that continued an uninterrupted drag.

metrics.name: resize.two_hand_stability_ratio
metrics.description: Share of resize frames that still had both hands.

assertions.description: A replay that measured almost nothing must fail loudly: empty metrics read as good ones.
A still hand must not wander more than one percent of the image width.

Most clicks must land on a target. The golden trace deliberately holds one near miss thirty pixels outside a button, so that changing the assistance changes this number: at the default reach it is two clicks in three, at full assistance three in three. Below two thirds, the resolver has regressed.
Informational: a broken drag is felt as a dropped object.
Informational: the filter may lag a fast hand, but not by a twentieth of the screen.
